trigger: A Lua harness validator, schema, fixture, documentation gate, or future runtime gate fails.
steps: Classify failure as contract, registry, fixture, host-interface, sandbox, lifecycle, external dependency, or runtime evidence.
Preserve passing disjoint evidence and repair only the owning surface.
Never rewrite acceptance criteria, fixtures, or proof ceiling merely to obtain a pass.
If the failure is outside harness-owned scope, stop and produce a downstream handoff with exact owner/dependency.
Rerun the focused gate, then documentation contract, then diff hygiene.
failureHandling: If repeated bounded repair fails or product/runtime code is required, stop the harness lane and hand off without claiming runtime proof.
proofCeiling: recovery evidence for the repaired gate only
